Detailed Description

template<class RecircBaseType>
class RecircBaseChain< RecircBaseType >

Creat a chain of allpass or comb delays.

Template Parameters:
RecircBaseTypeThis must be one of the following (otherwise you may get very strange errors): CombN, CombL, AllpassN, AllpassL. This will be used as the delay type.

Construct and audio rate RecircBaseChain chain.

Parameters:
inputThe input to the chain.
sizeThe number of links in the chain.
maximumDelayTimeThe maximum size of the delay unit in seconds.
delayTimeThe delay time in seconds. This is a Value class so will be evaluated for each link created (for most purposes some kind of random value would be useful here).
decayTimeThe decay time to decay by 60dB (in seconds). This is a Value class so will be evaluated for each link created. It may beuseful to use a random value here too.
